card.name: Subsection numbers in label headings
card.fires_on: The digit right after the decimal point in a numbered section heading, such as 5.2 or 7.4, just before the heading title. It also fires on the point itself in headings like 5.3.

modes.label: Digit after the point
modes.description: The subsection digit in a heading like 5.2, placed before a title such as Somnolence or Eye Irritation.

modes.label: The decimal point
modes.description: The point itself between the section and subsection numbers.

card.plain: It marks the subsection number in a numbered heading, such as 5.2 Warnings and Precautions, in a drug label.
